global_structure: Ancient stone amphitheater viewed straight on. Six broad horizontal stone seating tiers rise from foreground to background. A seventh rear wall spans behind the upper tier. A tall rigid rectangular stone frame stands at the exact top-center position. The frame has straight vertical sides, a straight top edge, sharp corners and a clear rectangular opening. The amphitheater geometry, tier boundaries, frame proportions, frontal perspective and overall composition remain fixed and unchanged.
global_frame_rule: The central rectangular stone frame is a permanent architectural invariant. Do not move, distort, widen, narrow, tilt, decorate, replace or break it. Preserve its exact rectangular silhouette and vertical symmetry. Any moon or celestial disk must appear only inside the rectangular opening of the frame, never above, behind, beside or outside it.

scenes.name: Calm Portal Initiation
scenes.subscene_description: Ancient Cypro-Phoenician stone amphitheater with six broad horizontal stone seating tiers, each progressively invaded by rolling sand dunes that spill over the weathered limestone edges. Massive dune formations curve through the tier space, their wind-sculpted ridges creating organic diagonal lines that contrast with the rigid horizontal geometry. The central rectangular stone frame dominates the top-center position, creating a portal opening above the dune-filled amphitheater. Front tier nearly buried in fine golden sand with only the uppermost stone edges visible. Middle tiers show dunes cascading between seating levels like frozen waves. Upper tiers reveal ashlar sandstone and mudbrick traces partially submerged in sand. Sand drifts spill over tier edges in smooth curved cascades. No human figures. No symbols. Only the monumental contrast between ancient architecture and the desert that reclaims it. The sky above burns with a hyper-dense star field.
scenes.subscene_visual_brief: Calm deep desert night over a dune-submerged amphitheater. White full moon rises from center left horizon, positioned left of the stone frame opening, casting cool blue-silver light across the wind-carved sand formations. Sand dunes fill every tier level, their curves catching the pale moonlight in sharp highlight edges. The sky above is impossibly dense with stars — the Milky Way's Sagittarius arm arcs diagonally across the heavens, a thick river of unresolved starlight and dark dust lanes. Hyper-dense star field with thousands of visible points, the galactic core glowing with faint blue-white haze. Deep blue night sky transitioning from indigo at zenith to cool silver-blue at the horizon. Zero atmospheric disturbance. Pure blue light establishing a hyperrealistic celestial foundation for portal transformation.
